name: gap_continuation_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: When NIFTY gaps >0.7% at the open (driven by SGX Nifty futures or overnight US/global macro moves), and the gap holds un-filled during the first 30 minutes, institutional participants treat the sustained gap as a directional macro signal rather than noise. At 09:45, when the index then breaks above the first 30-min range high (gap-up case) or below the first 30-min range low (gap-down case), VWAP-benchmarked algorithms receive a confirmed reference level and begin working large directional orders simultaneously. This coordinated institutional flow creates a 30-90 second momentum burst on NIFTY as multiple systematic strategies trigger on the same breakout event, producing a directional move capturable at 5-second resolution before the initial thrust exhausts.

indicators.name: gap_pct
indicators.purpose: Daily measure — no lookback needed. Same concept as original but applied to the NIFTY index open vs previous day last close. Index gaps are driven by SGX Nifty futures and global macro, not individual stock catalysts.

indicators.name: gap_filled_30
indicators.formula: any(low[09:15-09:44] <= prev_close) for gap-up; any(high[09:15-09:44] >= prev_close) for gap-down
indicators.purpose: FIXED TIME WINDOW (09:15-09:44 IST = 360 bars at 5s). Same 30-minute assessment window as original — not scaled by 12x, the window is the same 30 minutes. An unfilled gap after 30 minutes means institutional demand (gap-up) or supply (gap-down) is absorbing all opposing flow.

indicators.name: first_30_high
indicators.purpose: FIXED TIME WINDOW — same 30-minute opening range as original. The high of this range is the supply ceiling; breaking it signals institutional demand overwhelm.

indicators.name: first_30_low
indicators.purpose: FIXED TIME WINDOW — same 30-minute opening range. The demand floor; breaking below confirms sustained institutional selling under gap-down conditions.

indicators.name: vol_sma_240
indicators.purpose: Rolling 20-minute volume average (240 bars x 5s = 20 min). Original used SMA(20) on 1-min = same 20-minute history. Same TIME WINDOW at 5s resolution. Volume surge at breakout confirms real institutional participation vs a false breakout on thin volume.

buy_ce.confirmation: Close of 5s bar above first_30_high with volume surge

buy_pe.confirmation: Close of 5s bar below first_30_low with volume surge

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option pts = ~8 NIFTY spot points pullback from the breakout level. A legitimate gap continuation breakout never re-enters the opening range; if NIFTY reverses 8 spot points within 30 seconds, institutional flow has not materialized and the breakout is a headfake. At delta ~0.5, 8 spot pts = 4 option pts.
exit.target_rationale: 7 option pts = ~14 NIFTY spot points, the conservative lower bound of the first-leg extension after a confirmed gap-continuation breakout (typical range: 15-25 spot pts). Targeting 7 option pts captures this first thrust at 1:1.75 R:R within the 90-second time stop.

filters.vix_filter: vix_close < 25 — panic/event gaps above VIX 25 have unreliable continuation; slightly tighter than original's 28 to account for index-level noise
filters.time_filter: 09:45-11:00 IST only — same window as original; gap continuation thrust is strongest in first 90 minutes of trading
filters.volume_filter: volume > 1.2x rolling 20-min average at breakout bar
filters.trend_filter: gap direction unfilled is the core filter (implicit)
other_filters: skip if abs(gap_pct) < 0.7% — too small for genuine macro signal on NIFTY
skip if abs(gap_pct) > 2.0% — circuit-breaker territory; continuation reliability collapses

edge.edge_decay_risk: low-medium — structural macro-driven gaps persist; frequency risk if global volatility normalizes

adaptation_notes: Three key changes: (1) Universe from NIFTY200 stocks to NIFTY index — gap catalyst changes from earnings/upgrades to SGX Nifty/global macro, but the continuation mechanism is the same. (2) Gap threshold default lowered from 1.5% to 0.7% — NIFTY rarely gaps 1.5% (maybe once per month), 0.7% gives 1-2 signals per week. (3) Hold time compressed from 60-240 minutes to 30-90 seconds — we capture only the initial momentum burst at the range breakout, not the full-day continuation. The entry signal (breakout above/below first 30-min range after unfilled gap) is structurally identical.
weaknesses: Very low frequency: unfilled NIFTY gaps that also break the first 30-min range are 1-2 per week; insufficient standalone without both CE and PE sides active.
False breakouts after thin-volume gaps (holiday-adjacent sessions) trigger stop immediately.
Entry window 09:45-11:00 can miss the breakout if institutional flow starts earlier (09:30-09:45) on very strong gap days.
